rules.title: San Francisco Rent Ordinance, Section 37.9(a) (Just Cause Evictions)
rules.requirement: A landlord of a unit covered by the Rent Ordinance may evict only for one of 17 enumerated just causes, which must be the dominant motive. Expiration of a rental agreement or a change in ownership is not just cause. Just cause is also needed to remove housing services.
rules.penalty: Landlords who evict or attempt to evict unlawfully may face substantial civil and/or criminal liability.

coverage.summary: Applies to rental units covered by the Rent Ordinance, and also to some units exempt from its rent increase limits, such as units first occupied after June 13, 1979.

rules.quoted_span: In order to evict a tenant from a rental unit covered by the Rent Ordinance, a landlord must have a "just cause" reason that is the dominant motive for pursuing the eviction.
